constitution.addressContent: The registered address of the Panchayat, is C-4 /156, Keshav Puram, Delhi -110035, or such other place(s) as the Executive committee will decide from time to time. The registered office of the Panchayat shall be situated in Union Territory of Delhi.
constitution.areaContent: Whole of India will remain the jurisdiction of the Panchayat.
constitution.cessationContent: A member, who indulges in any activity against the aims and objects and/or carries on the activities in competition with the functions of the panchayat or in any way damages its goodwill shall be liable to be terminated as a member of General Body. The decision in this regard shall be taken after providing an opportunity to the member concerned for offering his explanation to the National Executive Committee and the decision taken by it in this regard shall be final and absolutely binding upon such member.
constitution.contactOfficeNote: For complete details of all parts and sections, please contact the registered office.
constitution.feesAffiliation: Affiliation fees for organizations: Rs. 5000/- per year or 20% of the membership fees collected in the affiliated organization whichever is higher
constitution.feesLife: Fees for life members: Rs. 5000/-, one time
constitution.feesOrdinary: Fees for ordinary members/Active members: Rs. 100/- per year
constitution.feesStructureNote: (As decided in the general body meeting held on 21st Sept, 2014 at Bhubaneshwar. Subject to review and change from time to time.)
constitution.financialContent: All the incomes, earnings, moveable or immovable properties of the society shall be solely utilized and applied towards the promotion of its aims and object only as set forth in the Memorandum of Association and no profit thereon shall be paid or transferred directly or indirectly by way of dividends, bonus profits or in any manner whatsoever to the present or past members of the society or to any person claiming through anyone or more of the present or the past members. No member of the society shall have any personal claim on any movables or immovable properties of the Society or make any profits, whatsoever by virtue of this membership.
constitution.memorandumDescription: View or download the complete Memorandum of Association document (Amended - 21 September 2014)
constitution.nameContent: The name of the association is ‘Akhil Bhartiya Grahak Panchayat’ and will be hereinafter referred to as ‘Panchayat’ in the Memorandum of Association and Rules and Regulations made thereunder.
constitution.objectA: To unite consumers into a closely knit, disciplined cadre organization and to develop organized strong independent consumer movement and to inculcate in them the sense of trusteeship, service and patriotism.
constitution.objectB: To educate the consumer at large and the members in particular through various means such as books, periodicals, leaflets, video cassettes and other mass media and to make them conscious of their rights & responsibilities and to strengthen the consumer Resistance Movement.
constitution.objectC: To assist the consumers to protect their interests against any of the unhealthy practices in the market and to do all within its means to establish their rights.
constitution.objectD: To disseminate information to the members in particular and the consumer at large in general by arranging lectures, meetings, seminars, exhibitions, documentaries and all possible mass media.
constitution.objectE: To establish research centers and to conduct higher education centers for activating ‘Bhartiya Grahak Neeti’ of the consumer movement, to start such centers in schools, colleges and universities and to encourage and assist them.
constitution.objectF: To solve consumer grievances by legal remedies such as filing of suits and proceedings in the courts of Law in the name of ‘Panchayat’ wherever necessary.
constitution.objectG: To help the nation by making efforts to correct the price structure, distribution and marketing conditions through various consumer activities.
constitution.objectH: To take all other steps to achieve the goal of socio-economic welfare of the consumers in general, and its members in particular.
constitution.objectI: To strive mainly for safeguarding the rights of the consumers throughout the country. To organize the consumers to fight for their rights. In establishing the rights of the consumers, the ‘Panchayat,’ will not work for profit motive and it will only help to safeguard their interest.
constitution.objectI_2: The Panchayat will also help all organizations with similar objects. The benefits of the Panchayat will not be denied on account of caste, creed, sex, religion and gender.
constitution.objectJ: To do all other acts helping the above referred charitable and social purposes.
constitution.objectK: The office Bearers of the Panchayat shall not contest any political elections.
constitution.objectsSubtitle: The aims and objects for which the Panchayat is established are;
constitution.part1NameContent: The name of the society is AKHIL Bhartiya Grahak Panchayat and will be hereinafter referred to as ‘Panchayat’ in the Memorandum of Association and Rules & Regulations made hereunder.
constitution.part1OfficeContent: The registered office of the Panchayat will be in the National Capital Territory of Delhi and is presently located at C-4 / 156, Keshav Puram, Delhi -35. The office of the Panchayat may be shifted to some other place(s) as may be decided by National Executive committee from time to time.
constitution.part2Content: The General Body of the Panchayat shall consist of all the categories of members of the Panchayat as mentioned in part-III hereinafter.
constitution.part2FunctionsList1: To hold at least one Annual General Body Meeting.
constitution.part2FunctionsList2: To elect five Active members of the panchayat to be included in the National executive Council after every three years.
constitution.part2FunctionsList3: To review and take note of the work done by National Executive Committee in the preceding year.
constitution.part2FunctionsList4: To discuss the accounts, Income & Expenditure, vis-a-vis, activities carried out by the Panchayat in the preceding financial year and to give suggestions to the National Executive committee in that behalf.
constitution.part2FunctionsList5: To impart guidelines to the National Executive committee preparing the budget for the next financial year.
constitution.part2FunctionsList6: To approve and give its consent about the various activities carried out by the National Executive Committee in the preceding year and to give suggestions for the forthcoming financial year.
constitution.part2FunctionsList7: To amend the rules and regulations of the Panchayat by not less than 2/3rd majority of the members of the General Body as and when the amendment is deemed necessary by the Panchayat.
constitution.part2FunctionsList8: The General Body of the Panchayat shall follow the procedure, laid down in section 12 of the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to make any change in its name or to alter, abridge or amend its objects and / or rules and regulations.
constitution.part2FunctionsTitle: FUNCTIONS OF THE GENERAL BODY (SADHARAN SABHA)
constitution.part2Title: PART-II: GENERAL BODY OF THE PANCHAYAT
constitution.part3ActiveContent: Those who devote themselves to the activities of the panchayat by voluntarily participating in the activities of the panchayat for a considerable period of at least two years, shall be considered as an Active Member.
constitution.part3FounderContent: The persons, by virtue of being initial signatory to the Memorandum of Association and Rules and Regulations of the Panchayat, shall be Founder Members of the Panchayat. They have voting rights.
constitution.part3InviteeContent: Experts, scholars, economists, consumer activists or specialists in different disciplines or persons of distinguished status in the country shall be nominated as ‘Invitee Members’ by the National Executive committee.
constitution.part3LifeContent: Those who pay one time life subscription of Rs.5000/= shall be treated as life members, on recommendation of the Natl. Ex. Committee.
constitution.part3OrdinaryContent: A citizen of India who agrees with the aims and objects of the Panchayat and is ready to abide by its rules and regulations and has attained the age of majority shall be eligible to become a member of the Panchayat. This membership is without voting right.
constitution.part4List1: All the founder members of the Panchayat.
constitution.part4List2: The Sanghtak of each affiliated prant Grahak Panchayat.
constitution.part4List3: Adhyaksha, Upadhyaksha, Sachiv and Koshadhyaksha of each Prant and one lady representative from the prant.
constitution.part4List4: In addition to above, 5 active members from each affiliated organization shall be the members of NEC.
constitution.part4Title: PART-IV: NATIONAL EXECUTIVE COUNCIL [RASHTRIYA KARYAKARI PARISHAD]
constitution.part5List1: To hold at least one Annual Meeting of the parishad to review overall working and to frame policies.
constitution.part5List2: To elect the National Executive Committee of the Panchayat after every 3 years.
constitution.part5List3: To elect Rashtriya Adhyaksha, Upadhyaksha, Rashtriya sachiv, Rashtriya Koshadhyaksha after every three years.
constitution.part5List4: To review issues related to consumers and suggest improvements.
constitution.part5Title: PART-V: FUNCTIONS OF NATIONAL EXECUTIVE COUNCIL
constitution.part6Content: The National President, vice presidents, secretary and treasurer may nominate rashtriya sanghatak at National level and prant sanghatak at prant level.

constitution.votingPowersContent: All the members except Invitee Members who are enrolled in the register of members at the beginning of the year or up to a particular date in a year as decided by the National Executive committee from time to time, are entitled to vote.
constitution.windingContent: The Panchayat shall not be dissolved unless two third of the members shall have expressed a wish for such dissolution. Upon dissolution, any remaining property shall be given to some other society with similar objects as determined by the members.

court.appealBody1: इलाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट ने महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय देते हुए साफ किया कि सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम 2005 में सिर्फ 30 दिन में सूचना देने का नियम है न कि तारीख पर तारीख देने का!
court.appealBody2: सभी कार्यकर्ताओं से अपील है कि सभी लोग आयोग में अपील दाखिल करते समय इस आदेश की प्रति संलग्न जरूर करें और आयोग को निर्देशित करें कि आयोग इस आदेश का पालन करते हुए 30 दिन में सूचना दिलवाए न कि तारिख पर तारिख लगाए। ऐसा न करने पर आयोग के खिलाफ माननीय उच्च न्यायालय के आदेश का पालन न कर रहे हैं कहकर कोर्ट में अवमान याचिका (Contempt Petition) दे सकते हैं।
court.appealTitle: अपील: सूचना आयोग को कोर्ट न समझे
court.highlight1Text: Under the Statute, Appellate Authorities are supposed to decide the matter expeditiously. Fixing dates of several months is not the intention of the Legislature.
court.highlight2Text: The Statute has been framed for public welfare and encouraging transparency. Therefore, authorities under the Right to Information Act, 2005 must decide matters expeditiously.
court.highlight3Text: The court ordered that the appeal in question be finalized by the authority concerned within 30 days from the date of production of a certified copy of the order.

faq.realestate.a1: Yes, when promoter obtains the completion certificate and occupancy certificate then the same will be made available to allottees individually or to Association of Allottees.
faq.realestate.a10: Only up to 10% of the cost of the apartment, plot or building can be accepted by the promoter before executing the agreement for sale. After that no promoter can accept any money from allottees without Agreement to Sale being registered.
faq.realestate.a11: Aggrieved person may file complaint with Adjudicating Authority for interest and compensation under section 12, 14, 18 and 19.
faq.realestate.a12: In the absence of any local law, conveyance deed in favour of the Allottee shall be carried out by the promoter within three months from the date of issue of occupancy certificate.
faq.realestate.a13: Allottees shall take physical possession of apartment, plot, or building within period of two months from occupancy certificate issued by authority.
faq.realestate.a14: Prior written consent of 2/3rd of allottees is required in case there is major addition and alteration in the layout plan, sanctioned plan and specifications of the buildings or the common areas within the project.
faq.realestate.a15: Transfer of project to third party cannot take place without prior written consent from two-third allottees and along with prior written permission of authority.
faq.realestate.a16: The promoter shall be liable for 5 years from the date of handing over of possession to the Allottee towards structural defect or any other defect as specified therein. The defect should be rectified within 30 days.
faq.realestate.a17: Allottees shall be liable to pay interest for a delayed period, at such rate as may be prescribed (rate of interest shall be equal for payment and refund).
faq.realestate.a18: Every Allottee shall participate in formation of Association of Allottees.
faq.realestate.a19: Every Allottee shall participate towards registration of conveyance deed of apartment, plot, or building.
faq.realestate.a2: Promoter shall be liable to pay premium and charges in respect of the insurance and such will be transferred for the benefit of the allottees or Association of Allottees.
faq.realestate.a20: Every Allottee shall take physical possession of apartment, plot or building within two months of issue of occupancy certificate.
faq.realestate.a21: Allottees shall be liable for penalty for the period of such default which may extend up to 5% of the plot, apartment or building cost.
faq.realestate.a22: Allottees shall be punishable with imprisonment for a tenure which may extend up to 1 year or fine for every day during which such default continues, which may extend up to 10% of the plot, apartment or building cost.
faq.realestate.a3: All the documents and plans after handing of physical possession shall be transferred to Association of Allottees.
faq.realestate.a4: Promoter after payment of all dues and charges will make available lease certificate to Association of Allottees.
faq.realestate.a5: In case registration is revoked then Association of Allottees shall have the first right for refusal for carrying out of the remaining development works.
faq.realestate.a6: He will be entitled to obtain information related to sanctioned plans, layout plans and other details of the project.
faq.realestate.a7: (i) If Allottee wants to withdraw from the project then he will be entitled for refund along with the interest and compensation. (ii) If Allottee does not wish to withdraw then he shall be paid interest for every delayed month.
faq.realestate.a8: Allottees can withdraw from the project and will be entitled for refund along with the interest and compensation. Also if such person is not Allottee but affected investor then also he can claim relief.
faq.realestate.a9: Allottees will be entitled for compensation for any loss caused to him due to defective title of the land, and there is no time limit for claiming of such compensation.

home.profilIntro2: Our goal is to transform the Grahak Andolan into a Jan Andolan—a true people's movement. ABGP addresses key consumer issues including food adulteration, MRP violations, banking depositor rights, cyber safety, and misleading advertisements. We work beyond caste, creed, religion, and gender for the welfare of all consumers.
